dedupe_keys.name: maldives critical infrastructure locations health education government buildings transport mosques

description: This set of tables lists critical infrastructure across the Maldives, compiled by the National Disaster Management Centre, the Maldives National Defence Force, the Land and Survey Authority and the National Bureau of Statistics, cleaned by the Faculty of Engineering, Science and Technology at the Maldives National University, and published by OCHA's Asia-Pacific office on HDX in July 2018. Six tables cover transport (harbours, airports and seaplane facilities), points of interest (bank branches, ATMs, stadiums), medical facilities (regional and atoll island hospitals and health centres), government buildings (police, defence force, atoll and island council offices, courts), education facilities from pre-schools to universities, and mosques. Records carry national and sub-national p-codes so they can be joined to administrative boundaries. Coverage: the whole country, island by island. Access: Excel files on HDX. Licence: public domain; free. Caveats: the provider leaves the caveats and method fields empty, the data date from 2018, and coordinates and attributes are not described on the page. Simulation uses are an exposure inventory of critical facilities on low-lying islands for sea-level rise, storm surge and tsunami scenarios, and planning of evacuation and service coverage between islands. Related records: HOT OpenStreetMap country exports and the Maldives entries of the GAR15 exposure datasets.
